headline: Institutions Leading KOSDAQ Rebound Load Up on 'Semiconductor Materials, Parts and Equipment' Basket
summary: After the KOSDAQ index broke above 900 and paused, institutional investors bought a basket of semiconductor materials, parts and equipment stocks. The report is based on recent trading.
why: KOSDAQ is South Korea's technology-focused small and mid-cap index, and semiconductor supply-chain stocks are sensitive to global chip demand.
